name: maven
description: Apache Maven build automation and project management tool for Java with dependency management and lifecycle support

mvn.description: Maven build automation tool for Java projects with dependency management, compilation, testing, and deployment
mvn.usage: mvn clean install | mvn dependency:tree | mvn compile test | mvn package -DskipTests

mvnDebug.description: Maven with debug mode enabled for troubleshooting builds and plugin development
mvnDebug.usage: mvnDebug clean compile | mvnDebug test | mvnDebug -X clean install
